_comment: Proposed domain split (phase 1 draft). One DynamoDB table per domain. Feeds the future mapping file.

Catalog.rationale: What we sell and how it is described/priced. Read-heavy, shopper-facing, changes rarely.

Inventory & Manufacturing.rationale: Stock levels, BOM and shop-floor work orders. Write-heavy, operational, not shopper-facing except stock check.

Sales.rationale: Orders, carts and the sales organisation (sales people, territories, quotas). Highest write volume; target of the live CDC demo.

Customer & Party.rationale: Everyone we know: persons, stores (B2B customers), contacts, addresses, emails, phones, payment cards, logins. Supports login/profile and is the 'who' for Sales/Purchasing/HR.

Purchasing.rationale: Vendors, what they supply, purchase orders. Independent lifecycle from sales.

HR.rationale: Employees, org, pay, shifts, candidates. Sensitive data (pay, national ID) isolated in its own table/IAM boundary.

Reference.rationale: Small shared lookup data used by several domains (geo, currency/FX, tax, ship methods, units, cultures). Read-mostly, cached in apps, copied into consumers where needed.

excluded.rationale: Database plumbing (version stamp, DDL log, error log) - replaced by CloudWatch/CloudTrail.
